The digest lists it as ticket **#8841**. Moss's 30 September strategic digest says Mateo Quiroga submitted it for Vantorre Group. Drivers on the second shift at Newark couldn't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. The digest also says you escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

Before you send it to engineering, one thing to check. On 1 July in #strategic-pod you wrote that you'd closed out ticket #8841 with support. That was about a kiosk tablet browser-cache issue, not Door 14. Either the number was reused or one of the two references is wrong. I couldn't find a Door 14 ticket number anywhere else I can see, so please confirm #8841 in the support system first.
